close_reason: Added PartialEq, Eq, Hash to DefaultVerifier, EcdsaP256Verifier, RsaPkcs1v15Sha256Verifier (alongside existing Clone, Copy, Debug, Default). Builds clean.
description:
Pass 2 idiom finding under epic PKIX-qwzx.

Three verifier ZSTs in `pkix-path/src/lib.rs` derive `Clone, Copy, Debug, Default`
but lack `PartialEq, Eq, Hash`:

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct EcdsaP256Verifier;          // line 1830-1831
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct RsaPkcs1v15Sha256Verifier;  // line 1872-1873
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct DefaultVerifier;            // line 3022-3023
```

Pass 1 (epic PKIX-hxu1) added `Copy + Default` to `DefaultVerifier` but did not
add `PartialEq, Eq, Hash`. The same gap exists for the two backend-specific
verifiers.

The Rust idiom for ZSTs is to derive every zero-cost trait from the
`Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash` set. Concrete benefit: lets
callers use these as keys/markers in maps, sets, and assertion macros without
needing manual wrappers.

Fix: change to
`#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]` on all three.

Locations:
- `pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1830` (`EcdsaP256Verifier`)
- `pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1872` (`RsaPkcs1v15Sha256Verifier`)
- `pkix-path/src/lib.rs:3022` (`DefaultVerifier`)

Sister issue: same pattern for the four profiles in pkix-profiles (PKIX-qwzx.18)
and the six lint ZSTs in pkix-lint/cabf_tls_br (PKIX-qwzx.17).
